profile_text.body:
Tobii Dynavox describes itself as a global, full-service provider of communication solutions for people with disabilities. Its site says the company makes communication apps and AAC devices, speech generating devices, and eye trackers controlled by eye gaze, touch and switch access. The company says its products are purpose-built for AAC, or augmentative and alternative communication, and are designed to be customized so clinicians can set goals for clients and adapt the solutions over time. The site names autism, ALS/MND and cerebral palsy among the conditions its solutions address.

The company's tracked product is Boardmaker, listed under Education and Research AI. It is described as symbol-based visual supports and AAC materials for teachers, therapists and students, with Student Center accounts under a teacher license. Pricing listed is Personal at $99/year for 1 learner and Professional at $199/year for up to 10 students, with organization volume pricing and a 60-day free trial. AI features for Boardmaker are not verified. Tobii Dynavox data privacy terms for Boardmaker Online are posted in the SDPC registry under New York Education Law 2-d.

The site also includes a profile of a physician, husband and father with ALS/MND who uses AAC to share his knowledge with his family and community. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
